numerical_checks.extra_check: A host callback before each synchronous pair must complete before execute(finish=true) returns; async/capture, guards, invalid inputs preserved

adoption_criterion: Code2K prefill andTTFT >=1% in both independent brackets; Prose2K no worse than1%; abs relevant arm drift<=3%. Not a statistical confidence interval.
limitations: Two samples per case/arm; no fixed GPU clocks or confidence interval
No claim for untested contexts or decode speed
MTP cumulative floor0 is historical benchmark policy, production uses0.5
6561 is experimental capacity; production auto sizing/reserve unchanged
1Hz physical-memory samples do not bound instantaneous headroom or prove no WDDM paging; READY is another counter
